_comment: Minimal Unity project for FUSE EditMode tests. Pinned to the Railroader Unity version (2022.3.62f2). Tests live in Assets/Tests/ and run via the Unity Test Runner. The DLLs FUSE links against (FUSE.dll, Railroader's Assembly-CSharp.dll, etc.) are not committed — FUSE.UnityTests/prepare_assets.ps1 copies them in from the FUSE build output and the game install before tests run.
